Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 just wowed developers with viral Dark Souls-style game demos today. Here's what you need to know.

Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5 on September 22, 2026, its new flagship model for reasoning, coding, and long-horizon agentic work, succeeding Opus 5. It's available on all platforms and priced at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, down 20% from Opus 5.

Forward Future's Alex got early access and posted demos he built with it, including a Dark Souls-style action game with real combat and level design, plus a doodle shooter. Commenters, including Matthew Berman, called it one of the most convincing FromSoftware-style recreations they'd seen from AI, with several stunned it took only a couple of prompts.

Key numbers:
- Release date: September 22, 2026
- Input pricing: $4 per million tokens
- Output pricing: $20 per million tokens
- Price cut: 20% versus Opus 5
- Fast mode: up to 2.5x speed at 2x standard pricing

Alex's original demo thread has drawn over 400K views since posting.
